title: FHIR Questionnaire Wireframe Output
description: The renderings of one built Questionnaire and their review, in the output shape of cat-harness `wireframe-design-review` (candidates with source HTML, web and mobile screenshots and their staging links; the choice; the changed assets; the staging deep links), plus the renderer that drew the form view, the fidelity findings against the L2 wireframe per layout, and the change requests received.

assetDir.description: Repository-relative directory holding the wireframes, the form-view captures and their checks.

candidates.description: At least two for Design use, exactly one (marked as-is) for as-is use.

id.description: Candidate id, shown to reviewers in place of its author.

source.description: Repository-relative path of the candidate's mid-fidelity HTML.

screenshots.description: Written by wireframe-check: one per viewport. A candidate with only one does not enter review.

staging.description: The candidate and its screenshots on the staging preview, as deep links.

entries.description: Script and review entries, per criterion. No scores, no averages.

reason.description: Why it was chosen or why it lost. Rejected candidates stay, each with its reason.

chosen.description: Design use: the candidate the human reviewer chose. Absent until they choose; an agent never records a choice on a person's behalf.

chosenBy.description: The requester or BA who chose it.

recordedAt.description: Where the choice is recorded: the issue or pull request comment, or, when it was made in the conversation, the proposal section that records it.

questionnaire.description: The built Questionnaire JSON rendered, as in the input.

renderer.description: What drew the form view. The vendored build, never a CDN at runtime (owner, 2026-10-14).

name.description: NLM LHC-Forms, the owner's choice of 2026-10-14.

assets.description: Site-relative directory the vendored files are served from.

licenceNotice.description: Repository-relative path of the NLM licence notice kept with the vendored files.

fidelity.description: check-wireframe-questionnaire's findings, one entry per Questionnaire and wireframe layout. Absent when no L2 wireframe exists; an entry whose status is `could-not-determine` (exit 2) is never a pass.

sdcChecks.description: The SDC build checks (fhir-harness `sdc-checks`, CSIRO's libraries), one entry per Questionnaire. `not-applicable`, `no-fixture` and `could-not-determine` are never a pass; a behavioural test's failure is a warning.

changeRequests.description: Change requests received through ✍ suggest or the questionnaire-change issue form, and where each stands.

changedAssets.description: Every file the branch adds, changes or removes — wireframe HTML, form-view pages, screenshots, reviews — in the changed-assets record shape a staging preview's graph carries.

criterion.description: renders, no-overflow, no-placeholder (script entries from wireframe-check); intent-fit, web-usability, mobile-usability, accessibility, alternatives (review entries).

by.description: `script` for a wireframe-check entry; the reviewer otherwise.

note.description: The reason. Required in substance for every warn and fail.

questionnaire.description: Repository-relative path of the built Questionnaire JSON.

wireframe.description: Repository-relative path of the L2 wireframe HTML it was checked against.

layout.description: The `data-layout` name, or `(whole document)` when the wireframe has one layout.

findings.description: The checker's lines for this layout, verbatim.

issue.description: The issue the request arrived as.

via.description: The ✍ suggest editor's Questionnaire mode, or the questionnaire-change issue form filled by hand.

edited.description: The side the requester changed. It is the source of the change; the other side is brought back in line with it (owner, 2026-10-14).

note.description: Why it was declined, or what was applied.

changedAsset.title: Changed asset
changedAsset.description: One file the branch adds, changes or removes, in the record shape of a staging preview graph's `changedAssets` (cat-harness-tools scripts/kg-changed-assets.ts `ChangedAsset`; glosses in schemas/vocabulary.ts: assetChange, assetKind, beforeVersion, afterVersion, assetSource, renderedPage, renderedPagesUnknown).

change.description: How the asset differs from main.

kind.description: What the asset is, without namespace: `questionnaire-wireframe`, `questionnaire-rendering`, `questionnaire-screenshot`, or a `wireframe-design-review` kind (`wireframe-candidate`, `wireframe-screenshot`, `wireframe-intent`, `wireframe-review`).

before.description: The asset as published on main; absent when it is new on the branch.

after.description: The asset as published in the staging preview; absent when the branch removes it.

pages.description: The rendered pages the source maps to, as before/after pairs (StagingPageComparison rows: the item shape of stagingLinks.pages).

pagesUnknown.description: Why the pages were not mapped one by one, when they were not; never read as 'renders no page'.

changedAsset.$comment: Mirrors ChangedAsset in cat-harness-tools scripts/kg-changed-assets.ts (PR #203, branch claude/staging-kg-changed-assets).

stagingLinks.title: Staging links
stagingLinks.description: The staging preview of the work a request for feedback is about: one deep link per changed page (the page and the anchor where the change sits) with the same page on main as `before`. Mirrors StagingComparison in schemas/staging.ts. The rule is skills/sdlc/sdlc-core/staging-review.md §"The deep-link rule". Copied inline as `definitions.stagingLinks` into every skill contract that carries it; schemas/staging.test.ts fails when a copy drifts.

slug.description: Branch slug used in the staging URL path.

pages.description: One entry per changed page, deep-linked; from the change's rendered-impact list, never chosen by judgement.

before.description: Same page on main; absent for a new page.

after.description: The page on the staging preview, with the anchor where the change sits; absent for a deleted page.

summary.description: What to look at on this page.

missing.description: What could not be linked, said rather than hidden: no preview yet (and when it will exist), no page list computed, or a changed page the publish ref does not hold.

stagingLinks.$comment: Copy of cat-harness schemas/staging-comparison.schema.json; cat-harness schemas/staging.test.ts fails when a copy drifts.

library.description: The npm package and version that ran it.

severity.description: `warning` for the behavioural tests (questionnaire-test-toolkit is early).

output.description: The assembled Questionnaire, when it was written.
